description: Zig HTTP/1.1 server on the zix.Http1 raw engine, .URING dispatch: per-worker SO_REUSEPORT io_uring loops, comptime Router, staged send sink. Dual listener: cleartext 8080, TLS 1.3 on 8081. DB endpoints ride the driver-owned multiplexed transports (postgrez plus rediz, .URING): fd-routed shard threads, named prepared statements, cache-aside crud with a Redis write-behind mirror.
